name: BigQuery Native Experimentation
overview: Run experiments in LaunchDarkly using data in your BigQuery warehouse to power your results.
description: Enable LaunchDarkly's experimentation platform to read and analyze data from your Google BigQuery data warehouse
author: LaunchDarkly

formVariables.name: Project and environment
formVariables.description: Select your LaunchDarkly project and environment. You cannot edit this after you save the configuration.

formVariables.name: GCP project ID
formVariables.description: The Google Cloud project that holds your BigQuery resources.

formVariables.name: Dataset location
formVariables.description: BigQuery region for your datasets (for example US or EU). All datasets must be in the same location.

formVariables.name: Results dataset ID
formVariables.description: Dataset where LaunchDarkly writes experimentation results.

formVariables.name: Data Export dataset ID
formVariables.description: The dataset where your BigQuery Data Export destination writes event data.

formVariables.name: Metrics dataset ID (optional)
formVariables.description: Optional metrics dataset for dataset-level access instead of project-level read access.

formVariables.name: Service account key (JSON)
formVariables.description: Paste the JSON key for the service account created by the setup script.

formVariables.name: Recurring Task ID
formVariables.description: The task id of the scheduled work task for this integration.
